map.σ_年 = σ_日×√252: sigma per year = sigma per day x sqrt(252)
map.→ 打开日波动率 × √252工具: -> Open the daily volatility x sqrt(252) tool
map.回测中按 250 个交易日或按 12 个月折算，结果需与 benchmark 口: In backtesting, annualise over 250 trading days or 12 months, and the result must use the same basis as the benchmark.
map.对样本期内每期收益率求标准差：σ = √(Σ(rᵢ−r̄)²/N)。本工具输入周: Take the standard deviation of the per-period returns in the sample period: sigma = sqrt(sum((r_i - r_bar)^2) / N). This tool takes the periodic volatility directly and multiplies by the square root of d to annualise.
map.差异极小（√250=15.811，√252=15.875，相差 0.4%）。A股: The difference is tiny (sqrt(250) = 15.811, sqrt(252) = 15.875, a gap of 0.4%). A-shares commonly use 242-250 and US stocks 252; what matters is consistency with the comparison basis rather than absolute precision.
map.已知某资产在一段样本期内的周期波动率（如周波动率、月波动率），需按实际周期数折算: Given the periodic volatility of an asset over a sample period (such as weekly or monthly volatility), annualise it using the actual number of periods.
map.年化波动率 = 日波动率 × √交易日数。: Annualised volatility = daily volatility x square root of the number of trading days.
map.日波动率 2%、按 250 交易日年化: Daily volatility 2%, annualised over 250 trading days
map.由个股与市场收益率协方差与方差求 β: Derive beta from the covariance and variance of the stock and market returns
map.跨市场比较时，各市场年交易日数不同（A股约 242、美股约 252），需显式指定: When comparing across markets, the number of trading days per year differs (about 242 for A-shares, about 252 for US stocks), so the period count d must be specified explicitly.
map.输入日波动率（或日收益率标准差）与年交易日数，按年化波动率 = 日波动率 × √: Enter the daily volatility (or the standard deviation of daily returns) and the number of trading days per year, then convert with annualized volatility = daily volatility × sqrt(trading days) for risk assessment and option pricing.
